title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Include approvals for requisition worksheets and item journals in your workflows (New standard workflows)
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) extends approval workflows to item journals and requisition/planning worksheets, allowing batch-level approval reviews before posting or converting documents. This prevents unauthorized modifications during pending approvals and works with Power Automate.
key_points: Item journals, physical inventory, output, and consumption journals now support approval workflows similar to general journal batches
Requisition and planning worksheets can be sent for batch-level approval before converting lines to purchase documents or executing planning
Active approval requests lock records against editing, deletion, or posting until approval is completed or canceled
Line-level approvals are not yet supported; approvals only work at the batch level for worksheets

quotes.text: When an approval request is created for a worksheet batch, you can't insert, modify, or delete requisition or planning lines.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how approvals prevent data changes during pending decisions, protecting planning integrity

quotes.text: Microsoft Power Automate support is available through updated workflow events and responses.
quotes.why_it_matters: Enables integration with cloud-based automation tools beyond Business Central's standard workflows
